verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for exporting a user's conversations, files, memory or agents in open formats. The only data-portability item is an 'Import Conversations' page, which covers the opposite direction. Self-hosted deployment via Docker, npm or Helm is a deployment property, not a documented export feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
